title: aquilegia vulgaris subsp. alpina
intro: Aquilegia vulgaris subsp. alpina, commonly known as Alpine Columbine, is a species of flowering plant in the buttercup family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Alpine Columbine include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, anti-cancer, and immune system modulation. Additionally, Alpine Columbine has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, digestive problems, and skin conditions.
